hook.line: Everyone talks about Claude Code, nobody shows you how to set it up; done in under 60 s.
hook.visual: Top: orange-framed terminal card with a pixel-font CLAUDE CODE logo on blue; yellow label 'Claude Code Beginners Guide (in under 60 seconds)'; presenter below, hand raised.

beats.what: Pixel CLAUDE CODE terminal card above the face, yellow title label promising under 60 seconds
Early CTA: yellow 'CLAUDE' sticker as he asks viewers to comment for the guide
Cut: top half becomes a live terminal screen recording as he says open the terminal
Install command shown as a black caption pill over the terminal, yellow comment reminder repeated
Zoom punch on the terminal as he types claude and signs in
Claude Code welcome screen: you are up and running
cd command label over the terminal, comment reminder repeated a third time
Cut to VS Code as the alternative for people scared of the terminal
Claude Code for VS Code extension page, hit install
Claude panel open inside VS Code, then a follow ask over a black end frame

why_it_works: A hard promise (under 60 seconds) in the title label sets a clock the viewer waits out
The screen recording always shows the exact step being said, so the face can stay put with only 2 cuts
The comment-keyword ask comes before the payoff and is repeated as a yellow label on screen
Fear is named and defused ('sounds scarier than it is'), which keeps beginners watching
weaknesses: 4.9 words/s with almost no cuts; the face half is static for 39 s
Breaks his own under-60-seconds promise by running 73 s
Small terminal text in a half-height panel is hard to read on a phone
for_robert: Keep a pixel-art product card in the top half for the hook; it reads instantly and matches Fred's style. Avoid long static stretches: give Fred a small reaction at each step.
